name: Tulum
blurb: Tulum remains one of the most discussed destinations in the country, with steady volume across the period and no unusual movement.

positive: Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
Good value compared with last year
Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
negative: Prices noticeably up on last season

quotes.text: Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Second time here and it still feels underrated.
